component.name: Talon Companion
component.summary: Chat with your self-hosted Talon agent

description.p: Talon Companion is the desktop client for Talon, an open-source harness that runs AI agents on your own machine or server. It connects to a running Talon daemon over its HTTP bridge and gives you a native chat window for it.

ul.li: Stream replies with Markdown, code highlighting and live tool activity
Browse, search and switch between conversations
Attach files through the system file chooser or by drag and drop
Pick models and inspect context, extensions and logs
Connect to a daemon on this computer, on your LAN, or behind a reverse proxy with a client certificate

description.p: This Flatpak is a client only: it needs a Talon daemon to connect to, which is installed separately. Features that act on the host computer, such as mesh device control, are not available inside the sandbox.
